title: The Last Light on Kestrel Rock

style.lens: He notices the weather first, then what the weather does to the people who cannot leave it.

characters.name: Ewan
characters.appearance: Gaunt and wind-chapped, in an oilskin coat gone green at the seams and a woollen cap pulled low.
characters.sketch: The last keeper of a lighthouse that the authority wants to automate.

wants.text: Keep the light burning by hand

characters.fear: That the light never needed him.
characters.flaw: Cannot ask for help without making it sound like a favour he is granting.

values.text: A job done in the open

behaviors.state: he is alone and the sea is calm
behaviors.tendency: polish the lens for the third time

behaviors.state: he is questioned about his future

characters.competence: Reads the sea and the sky and knows which storms will hold.
characters.speech: Slow, spare, rarely finishing a sentence he does not need.
characters.history: Followed his father onto the rock and has not left it for more than a week at a time.

characters.name: Nell
characters.appearance: Pale and brisk, with a salt-stained rucksack, a clipboard and a coat too thin for the island.
characters.sketch: A young surveyor sent to assess the lighthouse for automation, who finds she does not want to leave.
characters.fear: That she will always be the person who arrives to take things away.
characters.flaw: Avoids deciding by gathering more information.

values.text: Kindness that is not a performance

characters.competence: Notices the structural fault everyone else has stopped seeing.
characters.vulnerability: Being told she is good at her job.
characters.speech: Careful, exact, with a nervous habit of asking permission.
characters.history: Grew up moving between towns while her parents followed contracts.

characters.name: Dara
characters.appearance: Sturdy and sunburned, with rolled sleeves, a ferryman's cap and a laugh that carries across the water.
characters.sketch: The supply boat pilot who brings the post and the gossip and takes away whatever the island cannot keep.

wants.text: Keep the island on her route
Get her father to leave the rock

characters.fear: That the island will take the last thing she loves.
characters.flaw: Speaks lightly about what hurts the most.

behaviors.tendency: make a joke and hand over the post

characters.competence: Brings the boat through any swell and knows every rock by name.
characters.speech: Quick, funny, and kind in a way she would deny.
characters.history: Left the rock at sixteen and has been coming back every week since.

world.name: Kestrel Rock
world.era_and_technology: A small island with a coal-fired lighthouse, a wind-up foghorn and a radio that works when the weather allows.
world.everyday_life: The day is set by the tide and the supply boat, the radio crackles at noon and every meal is eaten at a table built for six.
world.history: The light has burned since before the island had a name, and the keepers who tended it are buried on the leeward slope.

places.name: The Lighthouse
places.description: A white stone tower with a spiral stair of one hundred and twelve steps and a great lens at the top.
places.effect: Makes every conversation feel like a vigil.

places.name: The Keeper's Cottage
places.description: A squat stone cottage with a coal stove, a narrow bed and a window facing the mainland.

places.name: The Landing
places.description: A short concrete jetty slick with weed, with a winch and a bell to call the boat.
places.effect: Makes everyone feel on the edge of leaving.

places.name: The Graveyard
places.description: A scatter of grey stones on the leeward slope, each marked only with initials.
places.effect: Makes visitors speak quietly and remember.

objects.name: The logbook
objects.description: A thick leather logbook with entries in four different hands.
objects.significance: It records every night the light has burned.

objects.name: The brass lamp
objects.description: A hand-polished brass lamp with a cracked glass chimney.
objects.significance: It is the spare light, kept for the night the great lens fails.

powers.name: The Lighthouse Authority
powers.nature: The distant board that manages every light on the coast.
powers.hold: Funding the island and deciding whether the light is manned.
powers.felt: A letter each quarter that begins with thanks and ends with a number.

rules.statement: The great lens must burn from dusk to dawn every night
rules.cost: A dark night is reported to the authority and counted against the station.
rules.when_broken: The authority sends an inspector and proposes automation.

terms.meaning: A night when the keeper cannot sleep because of the weather.
The sheltered side of the island, where the graveyard lies.

ties.bond: A father and the daughter who brings his supplies each week.
ties.edge: He wants her to stop asking him to leave.

ties.bond: A daughter who cannot decide whether to stay or take him away.
ties.edge: She wants him to say he is tired.

ties.bond: A surveyor assigned to assess the keeper's lighthouse.
ties.edge: She wants him to give her one honest reason to recommend it stay.

ties.bond: A keeper who answers to a board he has never met.
ties.edge: He wants them to see the light is more than a cost.

setup.normal: Nell measures the structures she is sent to assess, files the figures in a tidy report and leaves before anyone can ask her to stay. The routine keeps her moving and keeps her from belonging anywhere.
setup.disruption: The supply boat sets her on Kestrel Rock with an order to survey the lighthouse for automation, and a storm closes the sea behind it.
